traceability.notes: The `traceability/require-branch-annotation` rule is fully implemented and wired into the plugin according to story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS. The rule detects significant branch node types (if/else, switch cases, loops, try/catch/catch/finally), associates preceding comments (including special handling for SwitchCase), parses @story/@req markers, and reports missing annotations with a clear, parameterized message. Configuration via `branchTypes` is supported and validated; invalid types produce configuration errors as required. The helper module centralizes branch type definitions, comment association, annotation parsing, and fixers, satisfying the technical requirements (REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION, REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION, REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING, REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE, and nested handling via generic visitors). Comprehensive tests under tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts cover valid and invalid cases across many branch patterns and configuration scenarios, and the dedicated documentation file docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md provides examples and configuration guidance. The rule is included in the exported recommended/strict configs in src/index.ts. Based on this concrete evidence and the successful Jest execution, all acceptance criteria for this story are met.
